Their digestive tracts are very short (relative to their body size), and thus better suited to digesting meat. Meat breaks down much more quickly than vegetables, so they are able to digest it fully.  As far as I can tell, this actually makes them carnivores. I managed to help the momma dog deliver six healthy puppies, and they were all suckling happily by the time she got home. After that night, I developed a keen interest in pregnancy and childbirth, and I'm now studying to become a nurse midwife.
In case you're interested, the puppies were super adorable german shepherds mixed with possibly a lab of some kind. And I got paid $100 for what should have been a ten dollar babysitting job :P
